senses.gloss:
f. (-र्षा)
Impatience, envy of another's success; more properly read ईर्ष्या.

mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु)
Impatient of another's success, envious.
E.
ईर्षा and आलुच् affix: see ईर्घ्यालु.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Envied.
n. (-तं)
Envy.
E.
ईर्षा and इतच् affix, or ईर्ष with क्त aff.

mfn. (-र्ष्यः-र्ष्या-र्ष्यं)
Envious, envying.
f. (-र्ष्या)
1 Envy or impatience of another's success.
2 Spite, malice.
E.
ईर्ष्य to envy, and अच् and टाप् affixes; also, but according to the best writers, inaccurately written ईर्षा.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Envious, envying.
E.
ईर्ष्यं and वुन् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Envying, envious.
E.
ईर्ष्य and शानच् aff.

mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु)
Envious.
E.
ईर्ष्य and आलुच् affix; also written ईर्षालु.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Being overcome with envy.
E.
ईष्या and वश subjection.

mfn. (-र्ष्यी-र्ष्यिणी-र्ष्यि)
Envious, spiteful.
E.
ईर्ष्या and इनि affix. So ईर्ष्यावत् (-वान्-वती-वत्) and ईर्ष्यामय (-यः-यी-यं.)
